svg.title: Delivery roadmap
svg.desc: Five sequential phases from foundations through enterprise rollout.
svg.text: Delivery Roadmap
Phase 0 - Foundations
Weeks 1-3
• Provision EBS/NAS, XFS, NFS export, snapshots, and content-hash registry
• Configure WAL archiving, standby, snapshot lock, worker pool, and ACL schema
• Partition the audit log by month
Phase 1 - Pilot Corpus & Evaluation
Weeks 4-8
• Ingest 500k documents across two core business units
• Build hybrid BM25 + HNSW indices and run the golden evaluation suite
• Test restore / reconciliation and deliver the browsable Markdown QA corpus
Phase 2 - Agent Integration & Governance
Weeks 9-12
• Add citation-enforced synthesis, abstention guardrails, and query audit logging
• Export audit partitions nightly to WORM storage
• Obtain Compliance, Legal, Business Continuity, and RPO/RTO sign-off
Phase 3 - Scale Backfill & Optimization
Weeks 13-16
• Run unindexed full-corpus backfill followed by a batch index build
• Take full backups before / after the load; add reranking and latency tuning
• Load-test production concurrency and complete the first full DR drill
Phase 4 - Enterprise Rollout
Ongoing
• Roll out the full production service with continuous quality monitoring
• Run monthly restore tests and quarterly timed DR drills as standard operations
